trans-unit.target: TEXT_KINGML103_05477_SEQ_00<tab>Visna wears an uneasy expression.
TEXT_KINGML103_05477_TODO_00<tab>Speak with Visna.
TEXT_KINGML103_05477_TODO_01<tab>Place low-quality fire crystals at the designated locations.
TEXT_KINGML103_05477_TODO_02<tab>Speak with Visna.
TEXT_KINGML103_05477_ALPHINAUD_000_001<tab>We have much to learn about this world. Let us see what else Visna has to share.
TEXT_KINGML103_05477_ESTINIEN_000_005<tab>For a while I wasn't sure how we would fare, but it seems luck was on our side. Now we have an airship...albeit with a slew of caveats.
TEXT_KINGML103_05477_ALPHINAUD_000_010<tab>Back in the First, we had the Crystal Exarch to smooth over our introductions. Having no such assistance here, I must confess to feeling somewhat nervous.

TEXT_KINGML103_05477_ESTINIEN_000_015<tab>Speaking of inhabitants of other reflections...the voidsent of the Thirteenth. They're generally aware of the Source and its peoples, but I suppose having no familiarity with those from another world would be the norm.
TEXT_KINGML103_05477_VISNA_000_100<tab>Right, let's go speak with Ketill! ...Is what I would say, but my crewmates still appear to be wary of you all.
TEXT_KINGML103_05477_VISNA_000_101<tab>Seeing as that wariness is why I'm getting an extra cut, just to be considerate, it'd be best if you stay put. I'll have the captain come over instead.
TEXT_KINGML103_05477_VISNA_000_102<tab>Captain! There's something I want to discuss with you!
TEXT_KINGML103_05477_VISNA_000_103<tab>Come over here! It's perfectly safe, I promise!
TEXT_KINGML103_05477_KETILL_000_104<tab>Well, I'll be damned... To think that there were unbranded folk...
TEXT_KINGML103_05477_VISNA_000_105<tab>See? It's fine, just like I said!
TEXT_KINGML103_05477_KETILL_000_106<tab>So, what'd you want to discuss?
TEXT_KINGML103_05477_ALPHINAUD_000_107<tab>First of all, we wish to apologize for any trouble we have caused. And if I may, I would explain our situation.
TEXT_KINGML103_05477_KETILL_000_108<tab>Uh huh... Frankly, I don't know what to think about all this “other world” stuff...
TEXT_KINGML103_05477_KETILL_000_109<tab>But it's true that you don't have brands. You're clearly not ordinary folk, and I reckon you could do worse than meeting Visna's master.
TEXT_KINGML103_05477_KETILL_000_110<tab>That being the case, we'll take you to <var 1A 02 /var>Naglfar<var 1A 01 /var>─as the stranded survivors you are.
TEXT_KINGML103_05477_ALPHINAUD_000_111<tab>We are truly grateful!
TEXT_KINGML103_05477_VISNA_000_112<tab>Huzzah!
TEXT_KINGML103_05477_KETILL_000_113<tab>That said, we won't be setting off just yet. This isle here's perfect for our needs.
TEXT_KINGML103_05477_VISNA_100_113<tab>It's our duty to gather resources in this expanse.

TEXT_KINGML103_05477_VISNA_200_113<tab><var 1A 02 /var>Naglfar<var 1A 01 /var> has ships dedicated to securing materials, you see. Each vessel is assigned crew members─the captain, the pilot, the runesmith, and so on.
TEXT_KINGML103_05477_VISNA_300_113<tab>And it's our merry band that's been assigned to <var 1A 02 /var>Glaðr<var 1A 01 /var>!
TEXT_KINGML103_05477_ALPHINAUD_000_114<tab>So you will mine resources from this isle.
TEXT_KINGML103_05477_ALPHINAUD_100_114<tab>If you are not averse to the offer, might we assist with your work?
TEXT_KINGML103_05477_ALPHINAUD_200_114<tab>While poor repayment for our debt, we wish to be of service rather than sit idly by.
TEXT_KINGML103_05477_KETILL_000_115<tab>Well now, I won't turn down extra pairs of hands. Here, take these.
TEXT_KINGML103_05477_ALPHINAUD_000_116<tab>They're warm... Are these fire-aspected crystals?
TEXT_KINGML103_05477_KETILL_000_117<tab>Aye. Far from the purest stuff, but they've been treated to produce more heat.
TEXT_KINGML103_05477_KETILL_000_118<tab>As preparation for the extraction, I'd like you to set these crystals all over.

TEXT_KINGML103_05477_KETILL_000_120<tab>I'll have to move <var 1A 02 /var>Glaðr<var 1A 01 /var> away from the isle for the next step, so Visna will supervise here. You have any questions, you can take them to her.
TEXT_KINGML103_05477_ALPHINAUD_000_121<tab>Understood. We shall begin at once.
TEXT_KINGML103_05477_ALPHINAUD_000_125<tab>From my cursory knowledge of the subject, the mining process here appears to differ from that of the Source. It will be interesting to see how it unfolds.

TEXT_KINGML103_05477_ESTINIEN_000_130<tab>While there are those in Eorzea who dwell amidst the clouds, they may descend to the surface as necessary. To think that it has been impossible here for centuries...
TEXT_KINGML103_05477_VISNA_000_135<tab>While you set the fire crystals, the two of us will inspect the isle. Come and find me once you've finished.
TEXT_KINGML103_05477_VISNA_000_140<tab>Oh, and take care not to slip and fall off the edge. You might get lucky and land on another isle...but I wouldn't bet my life on it.
TEXT_KINGML103_05477_SALVAGECREWC_000_145<tab>In light of the battle, we need to assess the integrity of the isle's bedrock. Wouldn't want the whole thing to suddenly fall apart!
TEXT_KINGML103_05477_ALPHINAUD_000_200<tab>I've finished setting my allocation of crystals. If you have as well, let us report to Visna.

TEXT_KINGML103_05477_ESTINIEN_000_205<tab>I wonder why <var 1A 02 /var>Glaðr<var 1A 01 /var> had to move away from the isle. If they're extracting resources, would it not make more sense to leave the ship where it was?
TEXT_KINGML103_05477_SALVAGECREWC_000_210<tab>The bedrock appears to be sound, I'm happy to report. We can safely proceed!
TEXT_KINGML103_05477_VISNA_000_300<tab>Oh, you've finished already? That was fast... Do you do this sort of thing often?
TEXT_KINGML103_05477_VISNA_000_301<tab>An adventurer? I've never heard of such a profession. Traveling the world and taking on odd jobs... Such a life would be unthinkable here.
TEXT_KINGML103_05477_VISNA_000_302<tab>Tell me... Where you're from, are people free to travel as far as they like?
TEXT_KINGML103_05477_VISNA_000_303<tab>Or is it because you're capable that you can do that? Can travel so far, you can even come to another world...
TEXT_KINGML103_05477_VISNA_000_304<tab>...Sorry. We've only just met, and you're still trying to make sense of everything, yet here I am bombarding you with strange questions.
TEXT_KINGML103_05477_VISNA_000_305<tab>Thanks for taking care of the crystals so quickly! The captain should return very soon, so sit tight for now!
